title: "Tangent Hyperplanes II: Dynamics"
description: "Infinitesimal dynamics and moving tangent spaces."
---

## Local Linear Dynamics

Nonlinear dynamics are exactly linear in the infinitesimal.

$$
\delta \dot{x} = A(x)\delta x + B(x)\delta u
$$

## Moving Tangent Spaces

![Moving tangent spaces](figures/moving_tangent.svg)

As the system evolves, the tangent hyperplane evolves with it.

## Superposition

Superposition holds exactly within each tangent space.
